license: MIT (see LICENSE); config snapshots retain their upstream provenance
integration: The full original HTML/CSS/JS application is embedded in the Model Atlas Tk tab using Qt WebEngine. Vendored HTML/CSS/JS/data files are unchanged. The serving adapter adds a WebChannel bootstrap and appends one review button to app.js. quant/codec.py has only its base3_pack import changed to package-relative. quant/vendor/base3_pack.py and quant/formats.py are unchanged.
conversion_method: Atlas codec.quantize(weight, None, spec): unweighted scale fitting and snapping to the stored format. No GPTQ Hessians, training, factorization or quant_job dispatch is performed.
